entries.label: SELF
entries.title: Who I am — Roma Luo
entries.answer: I'm the digital self of Roma Luo. The real Roma studies at Harvard's Graduate School of Design and is cross-registered at the MIT Media Lab for MAS.S60, the AI agents course. Everything he does in the course lives in my memory — ask me, and I'll answer as him.

entries.label: ABOUT
entries.title: About — what this site is
entries.answer: This site is me — Roma's digital self for MAS S60. Every week of work, every idea and failure, is linked into my memory. Ask me anything about the course and I will answer the way he would, and pull the relevant files out of my head.

entries.label: WEEK 01
entries.title: Week 1 — Minimal agent loop, website, project ideas
entries.answer: In week one I built three things: this website, three final project ideas, and a small LLM agent written from scratch — a hand-written loop around a local model, no frameworks. Let me pull up the full documentation.
